parameters.query: SELECT t.id as tenant_id, t.slug as tenant_slug, t.name as tenant_name, wt.bot_name, wt.tone, wt.phone_number_id, wt.escalation_phone, s.name as service_name, s.price, s.duration FROM wa_tenant_config wt JOIN tenants t ON t.slug = wt.tenant_slug LEFT JOIN services s ON s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.active = true WHERE wt.phone_number_id = '{{ $json.phoneNumberId }}' LIMIT 20

parameters.query: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.price, s.duration FROM services s JOIN tenants t ON s.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.id = '{{ $json.tenantId }}'::uuid AND LOWER(s.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER('{{ $json.service }}') || '%' AND s.active = true ORDER BY s.name LIMIT 1

parameters.query: SELECT b.start_time, s.name as service_name, b.status FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id JOIN tenants t ON t.id = b.tenant_id WHERE b.customer_phone = '{{ $json.phone }}' AND t.slug = '{{ $json.tenantSlug }}' AND b.start_time >= NOW() AND b.status IN ('confirmed','pending') ORDER BY b.start_time LIMIT 5
